meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 装上后,你选定的 NanoClaw agent 群组会多出两个 Tavily 工具:网页搜索 tavily_search 和网址内容提取 tavily_extract,不需要 API key。工具说明和输入格式由远程服务器在运行时提供。
howto.when: 当你要为指定的 agent 群组安装免 API key 的 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取时触发。若群组本就在 Claude provider 上,它已有 WebSearch 和 WebFetch。

say.text: 给 group-1 装上免 key 的 Tavily 搜索和提取
say.note: 先查镜像里是否已有 mcp-remote

say.text: 把 Tavily 注册到这几个群组并重启
say.note: 注册和重启需管理员批准

say.text: 确认 group-1 的 tavily 配置里有那两个 header
say.note: 核对访问模式与客户端名 header

howto.what_en: After install, selected NanoClaw agent groups gain two Tavily tools: web search tavily_search and URL extraction tavily_extract, with no API key. The remote server supplies tool descriptions and input schemas at runtime.
howto.when_en: Use when installing keyless Tavily web search or URL extraction for chosen agent groups. Groups on the Claude provider already have built-in WebSearch and WebFetch.

say_en.text: Install keyless Tavily search and extract for group-1
say_en.note: Checks whether mcp-remote is already in the image

say_en.text: Register Tavily for these groups and restart them
Check that group-1's tavily config has both headers
say_en.note: Verifies the access-mode and client-name headers
